title: automobile/dealerships
description: One row per dealership location. Franchised dealers, each representing one manufacturer. Sales happen at a dealership, so this is the table to join through for territory and performance analysis.

name.description: Dealership trading name, the manufacturer plus the city it serves. Invented throughout.

manufacturer_id.description: Which marque this dealer is franchised for. A dealership sells one manufacturer's new cars, as franchise agreements require.

city.description: Spanish city the dealership operates in, drawn from real municipalities weighted by population.

province.description: Province the dealership sits in, always consistent with the leading pair of its postal code.

address.description: Street address in Spanish format. Dealerships cluster on industrial estates, as they do in reality. Invented.

postal_code.description: Spanish postal code whose first two digits encode the province, so the two columns always agree.

phone.description: Dealership telephone, carrying the dialling prefix of the province it trades in.

opened_at.description: Date the dealership opened. No sale in this dataset predates its own dealership's opening.
